title: Additive tensor-power section fractions over an ambient open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L,F$ module sheaves and $s\in\Gamma(X,L)$, and let $U\subseteq X$ be open. Define $Q^\Gamma(U)$ as the direct sum $\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\Gamma(U,F\otimes L^{\otimes n})$ modulo the additive subgroup generated by $\iota_n(t)-\iota_{n+b}(s^bt)$ for every $n,b\geq0$ and numerator $t$. Here $s^bt$ is the section map of mulTensorPowSection as used in [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation]. Write $[n,t]$ for the class of $\iota_n(t)$. This is the additive presentation corresponding to [def-sc-section-fraction-presentation], now over an arbitrary ambient open.
